chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Arithmetic operation on arrays are always applied element wise.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Let's start with simple multiplication operation.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Here we define a simple array so that we can easily track the changes.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: This will multiply each element by two.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Let's check the output.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: When using arithmetic operation, a new array is created and

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: the values are stored in that array.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: So our original array A still holds the same values.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: And this is our new array which we get after multiplying array A by two.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Observe that it is element wise multiplication.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Let's try division.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Here we use the division operation to divide each element of array A by two.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Let's check the output.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Observe that when you divide one by two, you get a value zero over here instead of 0.5.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: This is because both the array and the divisor are integers.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: If we would do 2.0 instead of 2, you will get float values.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Keep this point in mind before performing division in general.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: That is int divided by int will give you an integer output.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: To get float values, you need at least the numerator or

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: the denominator to be a float value.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Let's check the output.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Observe that we could successfully get a floating point value instead of 0.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: How about arithmetic operation using two arrays?

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: We will start with addition.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: We create another array B with these values.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Now let's just add A and B using the plus operator.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: As mentioned, this is element wise.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: This is our new array A plus B.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: One important thing to note here is that the shape of A and B should be similar.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Before the operation A plus B.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Else it will throw error.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Similar to the addition, you can perform subtraction.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Now let's move ahead with multiplying two arrays.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: This is interesting because unlike other many matrix languages,

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: multiplication operator when used with two array will not give you matrix product,

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: but will do element wise multiplication.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: That is, element at position 0,0 in array A is multiplied only with the element at

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: position 0,0 in B.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Let's print the multiplication of matrix A and B. Can you observe element wise multiplication?

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: But the next question would be, what about matrix multiplication?

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: How do you achieve that?

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Like for everything numpy has a function.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: It has function called dot, which performs matrix multiplication.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Similar to multiplication, division of two arrays can be performed.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Just include division operators between the two arrays.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Let's check the output.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: As seen before, since array A and B are integers,

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: we get the final array in the form of integers as well.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: If you want to see floating values, convert one of the arrays to float.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Well that's all for now.

chunks.title: Arithmetic operations
chunks.text: Keep practicing.
